summary: Advanced the remaining services-listing gate work substantially and cleared the previously failing repo-local Chromium/browser regressions. This iteration fixed the red `src/lib/tests/unit/service-contract/preflight.test.ts` suite by making its network env deterministic, expanded the service gate coverage in `.gitlab-ci.yml` to include the previously omitted service-contract / service-specific nostr / edit-conflict / docs slices, and cleaned up CI duplication/perf drift by excluding the timing-sensitive `services-perf.smoke` suite from `test:ci` coverage runs and by making `service-quote-e2e` run the non-visual browser specs explicitly instead of double-running the visual specs. On the browser side, I fixed the homepage featured-services loading-shell translation fallbacks in `src/routes/+page.svelte`, moved the instant-buy browser tests off preview-incompatible `/src/...` imports onto the existing `$lib`-backed route harness in `src/routes/e2e/service-harness.html/+page.svelte`, and stabilized the shared browse regression spec away from brittle internal shell markers. Verification now includes: `npm run build` passing with the full preview artifact contract present (`build/`, `.svelte-kit/output/server`, `.svelte-kit/output/client`, and `manifest.js`), `git diff --check` clean on the touched files, `npm run test:unit -- --run src/lib/tests/unit/service-contract/preflight.test.ts` passing, the full Chromium non-visual service aggregate passing (`24 passed`), the homepage behavior+visual Chromium slice passing (`4 passed`), and the previously failing targeted instant-buy/homepage/task-services Chromium rerun reduced to green. The main remaining local issue is one Mobile Safari-only browse regression where `/tasks` intermittently lands on the generic server-error surface during `tests/e2e/tasks-services-regression-browse.spec.ts`, leaving the final cross-browser aggregate at 23/24 on Mobile Safari rather than fully green. External GitLab merge-policy verification also remains outstanding because the required CI API credentials are not available in this shell.
